faqs.question: What is the ground footprint of the boreholes?

faqs.answer: Closed-loop geothermal (vertical boreholes) suits almost every project: small footprint, applicable everywhere, no dependence on groundwater. Open-loop geothermal is reserved for sites with accessible groundwater and sufficient flow.
